capabilities: Remove a background color from pasted images via right-click
Preview results live and pick colors with an eyedropper
Invert image colors for dark mode diagrams
Adjust tolerance and edge softening for cutouts
Save processed images to a tracked chroma/ folder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README warns the context-menu item may not appear unless the cursor is on an image link.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to strip a solid background from pasted screenshots or diagrams, so users must leave the app to edit images.
summary: Image tool that removes the background color from pasted images via chroma keying, saving transparent PNGs and updating embed links.
